11:   const resize = () => {
12:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;

14:   };
15:   resize();
16:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
17: 
18:   // Player definition
19:   const player = {
20:     w: 30,
21:     h: 30,

23:     y: canvas.height / 2 - 15,

26:   };

28:   // Input handling
29:   const keys = {};
30:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
31:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
32: 
33:   // Obstacle definition – vertical bar with a gap
34:   const obstacles = [];
35:   const obstacleSpacing = 200; // distance between obstacles
36:   const obstacleWidth = 40;
37:   const gapHeight = 150;
38:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
39: 
40:   let gameOver = false;
41: 
42:   const update = () => {
43:     if (gameOver) return;
44:     // Move player based on input
45:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) player.y -= player.speed;
46:     if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) player.y += player.speed;
47:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) player.x -= player.speed;
48:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) player.x += player.speed;
49: 
50:     // Keep player within canvas vertically (allow falling off for lose condition?)
51:     // We'll consider falling off top/bottom as loss.
52:     if (player.y < 0 || player.y + player.h > canvas.height) {
53:       endGame();
54:     }
55: 
56:     // Generate obstacles
57:     obstacleTimer += 1;
58:     if (obstacleTimer * 2 > obstacleSpacing) {
59:       obstacleTimer = 0;
60:       const gapY = Math.random() * (canvas.height - gapHeight);
61:       obstacles.push({
62:         x: canvas.width,
63:         gapY,
64:         passed: false,
65:       });
66:     }
67: 
68:     // Move obstacles leftward
69:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
70:       const o = obstacles[i];
71:       o.x -= 5; // speed of tunnel
72:       // Collision detection – player vs upper and lower parts
73:       const upperRect = { x: o.x, y: 0, w: obstacleWidth, h: o.gapY };
74:       const lowerRect = { x: o.x, y: o.gapY + gapHeight, w: obstacleWidth, h: canvas.height - (o.gapY + gapHeight) };
75:       if (rectIntersect(player, upperRect) || rectIntersect(player, lowerRect)) {
76:         endGame();
77:       }
78:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles
79:       if (o.x + obstacleWidth < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
80:     }
81:   };
82: 
83:   const draw = () => {
84:     // Clear
85:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
86:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
87: 
88:     // Draw player (glowing effect)
89:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
90:     ctx.shadowColor = player.color;
91:     ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
92:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
93:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
94: 
95:     // Draw obstacles
96:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f'; // neon magenta
97:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
98:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, 0, obstacleWidth, o.gapY);
99:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.gapY + gapHeight, obstacleWidth, canvas.height - (o.gapY + gapHeight));
100:     });
101:   };
102: 
103:   const loop = () => {
104:     if (!gameOver) {
105:       update();
106:       draw();
107:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);

109:       // Display Game Over

111:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
112:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
113:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
114:     }
115:   };
116: 
117:   const rectIntersect = (a, b) => {
118:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
119:   };
120: 
121:   const endGame = () => {
122:     gameOver = true;
123:   };
124: 
125:   // Start loop
126:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
127: })();
